# Econ-Management Paper Polish

> Evidence-first AI Agent Skill for economics and management paper writing,
> polishing, peer review, journal adaptation, method safety, and auditable revision.

Canonical website: https://linkingoscar.github.io/econ-management-paper-polish/
Source repository: https://github.com/linkingoscar/econ-management-paper-polish
License: MIT
Current version: v3.1.0-alpha.5

Primary documentation:
- https://github.com/linkingoscar/econ-management-paper-polish/blob/main/README.en.md
- https://github.com/linkingoscar/econ-management-paper-polish/blob/main/README.md
- https://github.com/linkingoscar/econ-management-paper-polish/blob/main/SKILL.md
- https://github.com/linkingoscar/econ-management-paper-polish/blob/main/references/v3-agentic-benchmark.md

Core boundaries:
- Never fabricate citations, data, results, methods, or journal requirements.
- Preserve numbers, variables, equations, citations, and causal strength.
- Deterministic safety gates override Agent preferences.
- High-risk scholarly meaning cannot be authorized by Agent consensus.
